jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Investment & Pension Products (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

The Investment and Pension Products tribe builds Raisin's capital markets–based products. We take complex, highly regulated financial systems and turn them into easy, transparent, and scalable product experiences. If you have prior experience in Product Management or related fields, have a passion for Fintech, and are eager to join us on this mission, this role is for you.


Your Responsibilities

  • Own one of Raisin’s Investments and Pensions product areas end to end, from problem discovery to delivery, adoption, and measurable business impact.
  • Develop a deep understanding of your product area (customers, market, regulation, competitive landscape) and identify the highest-leverage opportunities across the broader domain.
  • Shape and maintain a value-driven 12-month roadmap, balancing strategic bets, improvements, and platform/operational needs; align stakeholders through clear narratives and trade-off decisions.
  • Set and track quarterly OKRs with your Engineering Lead, ensuring plans are grounded, measurable, and connected to Raisin’s strategy; you’re accountable for outcomes, not just output.
  • Lead cross-functional collaboration with Engineering, Design, Data/Analytics, Operations, Legal/Compliance, and other stakeholders to deliver a seamless customer experience.
  • Communicate effectively through written product artifacts (e.g., PRDs, user journeys, wireframes, sequence diagrams, experiment plans, and release notes), providing enough clarity to enable autonomous team execution while keeping scope focused and aligned.

Your Profile

Must haves

  • At least 3 years of Product Management hands on experience leading a cross functional team.
  • Demonstrated success in defining, launching, and scaling complex products that combine deep technical systems, non-trivial business logic, and high operational or regulatory constraints.
  • Proven ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders (Engineering, Design, Business, Compliance, Legal, Marketing, Executive Leadership) and drive cross-functional alignment on product vision and prioritization. You have a sufficient grasp of these disciplines, such that you can sketch high-level solutions to product problems in software design artifacts.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Owner’s mentality: you tackle challenges head-on and drive solutions with conviction.
  • Highly data-driven approach to prioritization and decision-making, including the ability to define KPIs, create product impact dashboards, and synthesize data into actionable product requirements.
  • A track record of leveraging qualitative (customer interviews) and quantitative (product usage data) insights to validate assumptions and drive product strategy.

Bonus qualifications

  • Fluency in German.
  • Experience in Investment products, preferably with a leading European Fintech, investment firm or a Bank’s investment division.
  • Experience with Looker or similar analytical tools.

Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us!

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

jobs.title: Senior Application Product Manager - Supply Chain - Procurement
jobs.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team:

The Celonis Business Apps Supply Chain team is an innovative group of product and technology enthusiasts focused on creating and deploying next-generation solutions in the Supply Chain domain. We are transforming how enterprise solutions are built driven by our customers' business critical problems. Our team strikes an ideal balance between deep technical execution (including advanced data engineering and AI tooling) and a sharp customer focus to create highly impactful products that accelerate value realization across our customer base.

The Role:

You will gain experience in the Supply Chain and related processes and act as the interface between customers, our Go-To-Market and our Product & Engineering teams, shaping the future of Celonis’ product offering in this domain. Take this chance to rethink the way companies run their Supply Chain processes, with a specific focus on Procurement and help our customers to accelerate their value realization with Celonis.

As an Application Product Manager for Procurement, you will operate at the intersection of customer-facing solution engineering and core product innovation to architect and deploy cutting-edge enterprise AI solutions. In this hybrid role, you will partner directly with strategic customers to build bespoke, composable procurement and supply chain architectures using the Celonis Context Model (CCM) and advanced decision intelligence. By leveraging modern AI tooling and LLM-based coding agents, you will abstract field insights into reusable semantic libraries, directly accelerating Celonis' global agentic deployment workflows. You get hands-on: prototyping on the platform, wiring up data, building AI-driven solutions, and iterating directly with the people who'll use them.

The work you’ll do:

Your mission is to make the vision of AI-powered solutions a reality by building products that turn the cutting edge capabilities of the Celonis  Platform from strategy into solutions that customers use to run their Procurement processes.

  • Discovery & Solution Blueprinting: Conduct collaborative discovery workshops to uncover root-causes and operational inefficiencies, mapping ambiguous customer needs into clear technical scopes and comprehensive solution blueprints.
  • Context Model & Solution Deployment: Execute hands-on deployments of customer-specific context models, data structures, and end-to-end supply chain blueprints within the Celonis platform.
  • Project Management & Customer Value: Own customer deployments end-to-end from initial kickoff to live production, presenting complex architectural solutions and strategic value narratives directly to cross-functional stakeholders and executive teams.
  • Prototype & Test Functions: Design, validate, and test use-case-specific decision intelligence functions, including e.g. optimization algorithms and predictive models.
  • Context Generation: Deconstruct monolithic application architectures and translate deployment learnings into reusable semantic entities and modular context libraries.

If you are passionate about Procurement, Supply Chain, the Celonis technology, and what it can do for our customers, here's your chance to directly contribute to taking our Celonis Platform and Context Model to the next level.

The qualifications you need:

  • 4+ years of experience as a Solution Engineer, Product Engineer, Technical Product Manager, Founding/Forward-Deployed Engineer, Implementation Consultant or a comparable technical, customer-facing role hybrid role.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of core operational workflows in supply chain and procurement. You can speak the language of C-suite executives and seamlessly connect complex, systemic bottlenecks to strategic AI solutions.
  • A track record of building coherent solutions, not just isolated features. You think in terms of the whole solution and how the pieces fit together.
  • Expert in dat

jobs.title: (Senior) Project Manager Post Merger Integration [m/w/d]
jobs.description:

Nach dem Buy-and-Build-Prinzip vereinen wir 12 spezialisierte Tochtergesellschaften unter einem Dach, jede mit eigener Expertise und einer gemeinsamen Vision. Wir verstehen uns als starker IT-Partner für den deutschen Mittelstand und bieten unseren Kunden ganzheitliche Lösungen entlang der gesamten IT-Wertschöpfungskette: von Managed Services über Cloud-Infrastruktur bis hin zu IT-Security.

Was uns antreibt? Der Anspruch, mittelständische Unternehmen mit maßgeschneiderter, zuverlässiger IT pragmatisch und partnerschaftlich nach vorne zu bringen.

jobs.title: Product Manager, BSG (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
A career driven by you. Join AutoScout24 Group and experience life in the fast lane. We’re not just leading the market; we’re creating it. We’re constantly innovating, evolving and transforming things for our customers. We’re driven, ambitious and determined to do our best work, together. For a career that doesn’t stand still, where you can put your ideas in the driving seat and change the way the world moves, join our international community. 

Join our Product Management team in designing and managing the product vision. You’ll work independently, setting the north star, defining the scope, executing freely, and leading from behind. Consider it your own, mini-start-up. You’ll work untethered, focused on the user, with modern tools in a dynamic environment.

What you’ll do:

  • Define vision as well as business goals for the Engagement product area within the AutoScout24 buyer experience, focusing on driving user activation, engagement, and retention and translate them into a strategy and concrete product streams
  • Develop a product roadmap and milestones that reflect expected engagement outcomes, using data insights and experimentation to inform prioritization
  • Align priorities across the product organization with stakeholders, ensuring your work supports broader company goals
  • Own the end-to-end product lifecycle in your cross-functional team: deeply understand the customer, develop hypotheses, validate ideas through A/B testing, and iterate based on results. Collaborate to craft culture with our top tier leadership team while mentoring and coaching PMs and those around you
  • Establish, support, and ensure compliance of company product management methods and tools
  • Define success metrics around engagement and retention, and regularly communicate performance, learnings, and impact across the organization

What you’ll bring: 

  • Digital product management experience, preferably in Marketplaces or eCommerce
  • Strong customer focus with proven track record of building products from MVP to “world-class” using insights from tracking, user testing and A/B tests
  • Ideally knowledge in conversion rate optimisation (CRO) as well as testing frameworks and tools
  • Very good analytical skills with the ability to use data to backup ideas and assumptions, develop insights and recommendations and define and measure success metrics
  • Self-management, negotiation technique, conflict management and strategic thinking
  • Strong business knowledge and team development experience
  • Extensive know-how of common product management tools and knowledge of target groups
  • Product and cross-departmental entrepreneurial thinking and acting

A culture of growth  

With over 50 nationalities represented, we’re proud to welcome people of all backgrounds to our growing community, and we’re always finding new ways to help people feel welcomed and included. Here, you’ll have the tools, training and support you need to work in a way that suits you, learn new skills and reach your potential.  

For a career where you can drive our business and shape your future, apply now.

jobs.title: Product Management Director – Soft FM & Estates (UK)
jobs.description:
About SINGU 
 
 At SINGU , we’re redefining how the world’s most ambitious real estate companies run their operations. Our mission is to become Europe’s leading platform for managing warehouse, logistics, retail, and multi-site commercial real estate portfolios — empowering our Clients to protect revenue, boost efficiency, and unlock new value across every aspect of their business.
  
 Our unified CAFM platform already powers the daily operations of over 250 million m² of real estate worldwide , supporting more than 500,000 professionals. Following our union with the UK’s Micad and Germany’s net-haus, we now help manage 100,000+ buildings across 35+ countries — and we’re just getting started.
  
 Backed by a leading growth equity investor, we’re scaling rapidly and partnering with global leaders such as Prologis, ECE, CTP, Hillwood, Logicor, GLP, and Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. As we continue to grow through strategic acquisitions and bold innovation, we stay true to our core values: adaptability, collaboration, and client focus. 
  
 If you’re ready to help build Europe’s leading platform for property operations — and make a tangible impact on how the real estate industry works — join SINGU and be part of this transformation. 
 
 About the Role 
 
 You'll own a significant slice of the SINGU product suite: space management and Soft FM services – cleaning standards, portering, and catering – used every day primarily across the UK healthcare market . Product-market fit is established and thousands of users depend on these products daily. What the portfolio needs now is strategic direction and taking them to their next level of growth.
 You'll do that through a team of four Product Managers who are domain experts in the products they run. This is a hands-on leadership role . You'll stay close to customer problems yourself, you'll raise the bar on how the team discovers and validates work, and you'll have real autonomy to decide what's worth building – and to prove it works.
 SINGU group grows both organically and through acquisition, and several of these products arrived with the companies that built them. You'll shape the strategy for bringing them into one coherent ecosystem and lead your team through that change. If you enjoy taking a set of good but separate products and making them add up to something bigger, that is the interesting part of this job.
 You'll partner closely with Sales, Engineering, and Product colleagues across the SINGU Group so your portfolio drives revenue and solves real problems across the European FM market. AI is a must-have lever in our industry rather than a talking point: you'll be applying it where it measurably improves how our customers run their estates.
 This is a remote position with periodic travel to London and Kraków – roughly every two to four weeks.
 
 Role Scope 
 
 People Leadership & Team Development: 
 Manage and develop the Product Managers within the product team.

 Own the full management lifecycle: hiring, onboarding, mentorship, feedback, coaching, performance evaluations, promotions, and exits .

 Foster a high-performing product culture based on customer empathy, data-driven decision-making, and outcome orientation.

 Manage staffing and focus areas across the suite, reallocating product resources where needed to balance discovery workload and meet strategic priorities.

 Lead the team through change – new ways of working, a shifting portfolio, and product consolidation – bringing people with you rather than around them.

 
 Product Discovery & Strategy: 
 Define and maintain product roadmaps aligned with business objectives, customer needs, and market trends.

 Decide where to invest and where to hold : set a clear, defensible position on which initiatives scale and communicate it across the business.

 Build strong alignment with the Sales team to ensure product discovery and roadmap priorities actively unblock deals and support revenue growth.

 Identify and resolve ambiguities, dependencies, and competing priorities that impact discovery quality and speed.

 
 Product Management Best Practices & Standards: 
 Promote modern product practices, including continuous discovery, outcome-based roadmapping, and hypothesis-driven development .

 Ensure product teams consistently validate assumptions through user research, experimentation, and data analysis .

 Drive improvements in requirements quality, stakeholder communication, prioritization frameworks, and release planning.

 Cooperate with the Chief Architect and Engineering Managers to ensure product decisions account for technical feasibility and platform constraints.

 Drive the adoption of AI-powered tools and analytics to improve product insights, customer understanding, and decision-making quality.

 
 Collaboration & Cross-Company Coordination: 
 Coordinate with commercial and customer-facing teams to align product strategy with go-to-market plans and revenue goals for the portfolio.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Giftcard)
jobs.description:
Atolls is the world's largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets. 

 We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

 Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you'll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

 
 
 About This Role: 

 We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across France, Germany, and Spain.

 This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll set the strategy for a business line generating triple-digit YoY growth in some markets, own the commercial relationships with our gift card providers, and work directly with our Fulfilment leadership on where the vertical goes next. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio.

 We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding.

 
 Our Benefits: 

 At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

 
 A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.

 A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.

 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.

 A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.

 Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.

 Mental health coaching to support your well-being.

 Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.

 The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.

 A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

 
 *These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location. 

 
 Responsibilities: 

 In this role, you will:

 
 Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience.

 Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance.

 Drive revenue growth across markets - set and deliver GMV and commission targets across France, Germany, and Spain, backed by rigorous transaction-level analysis.

 Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension.

 Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet.

 Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction.

 Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform.

 
 
 Your Profile: 

 We're looking for someone with {explicit job content} experience, who is dedicated to creating exceptional user experiences and driving innovation.

 
 5+ years in product management , including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a leading tech company and/or a startup.

 A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit.

 Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features.

 Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring.

 Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them.

 Excellent stakeholder management - able to influence and present confidently to senior/executive stakeholders.

 A degree from a top-tier university (e.g. Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, HEC Paris, ESSEC, Sciences Po, Bocconi, ETH Zurich

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About MUBI
 MUBI is a global streaming service, production company and film distributor dedicated to elevating great cinema. To make this possible, we create, curate, acquire and champion visionary films, bringing them to audiences all over the world. We have a team of brilliant, dedicated and passionate people to help bring our mission to life. From London to New York, Istanbul to Paris, and Berlin to Mexico - we work together to realize MUBI’s vision.
 That’s where you come in! Join our global team and help us make great cinema accessible to everyone, everywhere.
 
 About the role

 This is a senior, hands-on product role for someone who wants to own a meaningful slice of the MUBI product end-to-end, and is at their best when the problem is still ambiguous.

 You’ll own the Audience & Platform Expansion domain - a critical product surface for our next phase of growth. In this role, you will be responsible for building the scalable foundation to drive global subscriber acquisition and pioneer our tiered premium offerings. You’ll own its strategy, its roadmap and its delivery, from a high-level business goal all the way to a shipped, measured feature. The hardest product problems at MUBI cross team and time-zone boundaries, and break down without someone holding the whole picture; this role exists to be that person for one of these domains.

 Reporting to our Senior Product Director, this is a senior, individual contributor role. You'll lead through clarity and influence rather than headcount - aligning engineering, design and data scientists around a vision they actually believe in, and mentoring/coaching other, more junior PMs as you go. We care about craft, in the films we champion and in the products we build, so the bar is product excellence and real user impact, not shipping for its own sake.

 We work hybrid-remote where we require 3 office days in Soho, London (if you're in commutable distance from London). Our core days are Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday, with the flexibility to use our offices on the remaining two days if you wish.
 
 Where you'll have impact

 You'll own a product surface that leadership relies on, translating ambiguous, evolving priorities into a roadmap teams can execute against - and giving the business a crisp, honest read on what's working, what isn't, and what needs a decision. As you build credibility through delivery, you'll set the standard for how product strategy is articulated and defended at MUBI. Concretely, you'll:
 Translate business goals into clear, actionable product roadmaps, and own the sub-strategy for a specific MUBI area (e.g. onboarding, content/catalogue discovery, monetization, or viewer experience).

 Guide technical products through the entire lifecycle - from conception, through development, into launch - and iterate after.

 Partner directly with Engineering, UX/UI Design, Data Science, Marketing, Business Development and Legal to define product requirements and resolve trade-offs.

 Establish the KPIs and OKRs for your area, and use data-backed insight to iterate quickly and demonstrate measurable impact.

 Pitch roadmaps to senior leadership to guide resource allocation, and align engineering, design and analytics teams without relying on direct hierarchy.

 Write narrative strategy memos and present complex visions clearly - to senior leadership and engineering teams alike.

 Mentor other team members and raise the bar for product thinking around you.

 
 What you'll bring

 You've spent significant time shipping complex technical products end to end, and you're happiest owning a problem from the messy, ambiguous start rather than picking up a tidy backlog. You bring structure where there is none - a clear strategy, sharp prioritisation, honest measurement - without becoming a source of process for its own sake.

 You're technically fluent enough to hold your own with strong engineers: you can translate an ML model, a streaming architecture or a latency constraint into a business trade-off a stakeholder can act on, and tell a real architectural limit from a convenient one.

 You're an excellent communicator who can flex between an engineer and an executive in the same hour, equally comfortable writing a strategy memo and defending it in a leadership review.

 You lead through influence - aligning people across functions, regions and time zones around work they want to do.

 
 Qualifications & Expectations
 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Design, or equivalent practical experience.

 8+ years in product management or a closely related technical role, with at least 3–5 years focused on shipping complex technical products from 0 to 1.

 Strong business judgment and strategic thinking - able to see the big picture and make connections across teams and issues.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Payments
jobs.description:
About ThriveCart: 

 ThriveCart is a powerful platform used by over 50,000 people worldwide to generate over $5B in sales. Included within the ThriveCart platform is a learning management system (LMS), affiliate management, cart and checkout functionality, making it a top solution for creators, coaches, consultants, and other businesses.

 We integrate with everything you use and have a simple, clean UI with numerous features that allow customers to build income from existing traffic and we are the highest-converting cart for online businesses. Our business is growing, profitable, and backed by LTV SaaS Growth Funds, and we are looking to expand our footprint amongst online businesses.

 Location: 

 Remote ( Europe) 

 Job Overview: 

 We’re looking for a strategic and execution-focused Product Manager – Payments to lead the development, optimization, and scale of our global payments infrastructure. In this role, you’ll be responsible for driving core payment functionality, expanding payment method options, improving checkout experiences, and ensuring reliability, security, and compliance across the payments stack.

 You’ll work cross-functionally with engineering, design, compliance, operations, and customer success to ensure our merchants have a seamless and trusted payment experience—whether they’re selling digital products, subscriptions, or services.

 Tasks

 What Your Work Will Entail: 

 
 Own and execute the end-to-end product strategy and roadmap for ThriveCart’s payments ecosystem (e.g., checkout, payment gateways, transaction routing, fraud, refunds, treasury, and reconciliation).

 Define, prioritize, and deliver features that improve conversion rates, reduce friction, and support global scalability.

 Partner with engineering and design to deliver high-quality user experiences and robust back-end systems.

 Integrate and maintain third-party payment providers (e.g., Stripe, PayPal, Authorize. net) and explore new options (e.g., local payment methods, wallets, and bank debits).

 Ensure all payment solutions meet regulatory requirements (PCI, PSD2, SCA, etc.).

 Monitor performance, adoption, and reliability of payment systems using data and user feedback.

 Collaborate with customer success and support to identify and resolve user pain points related to payments.

 Stay informed about global payment trends, technologies, and fintech regulations, and bring ideas forward that align with ThriveCart’s growth.

 
 Requirements

 What You Bring To This Role: 

 
 Proven track record of building and scaling payments systems in a SaaS, fintech, or eCommerce environment.

 Deep understanding of payment infrastructure, including gateway integrations, card networks, fraud prevention, settlements, and chargebacks.

 Strong technical fluency—comfortable working closely with engineers and interpreting API documentation.

 Excellent communication, prioritization, and stakeholder management skills.

 Strong data-driven mindset—you understand what to track, how to measure it, and how to use insights to iterate quickly.

 3–5+ years of experience as a Product Manager, ideally with direct ownership over payment products or platforms.

 Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Business, Finance, Economics, or related discipline) preferred but not required.

 Equivalent practical experience in product management, payments, or fintech may substitute for formal education.

 Certifications in product management (e.g., Pragmatic, AIPMM, or CSPO) or fintech/payments (e.g., ETA CPP) are a plus but not mandatory.

 Experience working in agile, cross-functional teams with a focus on delivering customer-centric solutions.

 Experience with global payment methods, subscriptions, recurring billing, or tax compliance tools.

 Experience with payments orchestration systems and/or treasury systems is considered a plus.

 Experience of using AI Agents and implementing and building AI tools and Agents

 
 Learn More About ThriveCart: 

 Our Values are: 

 
 Commit to Excellence

 Find a Way

 Help Each Other

 Keep Growing

 Data First

 
 Our team and product are growing rapidly- we achieved YoY growth of 64% from 2022-2023, and we’re just getting started. We believe in open communication, clear goal setting, and that people do best when they have a growth mindset and want to get things done. Our team comes from diverse backgrounds and companies like Shopify, Salesforce, and BigCommerce, and we are running like an independent SaaS company within a PE fund.

jobs.title: AI Product Owner - Leeds
jobs.description:
About Legal 500 
 
 Legal 500 is a global legal market research, data and intelligence business. Our research helps corporate clients make informed decisions about legal representation and gives law firms insight into their market position, performance, and clients.
 
 Beyond research, we’re building a growing data, benchmarking, market-intelligence and subscription service offering. We bring the legal market together through a global programme of events - awards ceremonies, conferences and roundtables that convene leading law firms, in-house teams and their advisers. And through Legal Business, our journalistic title, we deliver independent news, analysis and commentary on the business of law and the strategy, performance and leadership of the world’s leading law firms.
 
 We are a growing, multi-site organisation, with colleagues working across research, data, technology, product, journalism, commercial and events in London, Leeds and Bristol.
 About the Role: 

 Our new AI Product Owner will provide central product ownership for AI capabilities developed and used across Legal 500, spanning multiple business units, functions and AI products. 
 We see the primary premise of this role is to ensure that investment in AI is prioritised against Legal 500’s business objectives, that products solve clearly defined business problems, and that appropriate quality, governance, human oversight and accountability are built into their lifecycle.
 
 
 What you'll do: 
 
 You will have the opportunity to operate as centrally within Legal 500, sitting within the 'Project' unit within our People & Business Operations function. You'll work across business-unit leaders, users, Technology, Data, Governance and relevant technology partners or suppliers. 
 You'll be accountable for maintaining an enterprise AI product portfolio and roadmap and have responsibility for translating business needs into prioritised product requirements. This role is also about overseeing adoption and value realisation and ensuring AI products continue to improve as Legal 500’s operating models evolve. There is a possibility we may grow this team out to support on AI-specific engineering tasks.
 
 
 What we're looking for: 
 Essential 
 Strong product ownership background, ideally managing a portfolio of products or initiatives across multiple functions in an AI, data, digital or knowledge-intensive environment in a business change context

 Good understanding of how generative AI and related technologies can be applied to business processes (this role is not about having deep engineering expertise)

 Ability to quickly understand different business functions and complex processes, and translate them into clear product requirements, priorities and measurable outcomes

 Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to challenge AI outputs and understand issues such as hallucination, bias, confidence and evidence quality

 Experience working across multiple business units and technology teams, balancing competing priorities and communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

 Curious and comfortable challenging established ways of working with a commercial and outcome-focused approach rather than technology-led

 Comfortable working in an evolving environment where AI capabilities and operating practices will continue to change.

 
 Desirable 
 An understanding of professional services, publishing, legal markets, research or other knowledge-intensive environments would be advantageous.
 

 Role information: 
 Hybrid workplace - 3 days a week in office, 2 days remote

 This role can be based in either London or Leeds

 Occasional travel to the other offices may be required (Bristol, London and Leeds)

 We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. In just 18 months, our clinical AI products have absorbed the administrative chaos of 73 million patient visits. Today, we support over 2.5 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries.

We’re looking for a Clinical Product Manager who knows that system from the inside and wants to rebuild it.

 Map the whole journey, from study set-up and trial awareness through matching, consent, referral, site intake, screening, enrollment and retention. Find where software removes delay without weakening clinical or operational control.

 Make pre-screening safe to trust. Turn complex inclusion and exclusion criteria into workflows that are explainable, reviewable and obvious to a coordinator under time pressure.

 Ship with design and engineering. Translate ambiguous clinical and commercial needs into crisp problem statements, prototypes, requirements and sequenced releases, then stay close through validation, launch and iteration.

 Build trust into the product. Partner with clinical, legal, privacy, security and quality so consent, traceability, explainability, role-based access, auditability and human review are designed in from the start.

 Make pragmatic integration and data calls across EHR/EMR, CTMS, EDC, eConsent, ePRO, trial registries, identity and communications systems.

 Measure outcomes, not output. Define the funnel metrics that matter: time to match, referral completeness, site response time, pre-screening effort, screen-failure rate, enrollment conversion, retention and user trust.

 
 If we’d worked together the last 6 weeks 
 You’d have sat in on screening visits at three research sites and come back with the two reasons coordinators still keep a paper eligibility checklist next to the CTMS.

 You’d have taken one sponsor’s protocol, turned its inclusion and exclusion criteria into a working pre-screening prototype, then watched a research nurse try to break it.

 You’d have shipped the first version of referral tracking and found that site response time, not patient interest, was the thing killing conversion.

 You’d have argued us out of an integration. The registry data looked useful until you traced how stale it was.

 You’d have written the one-pager that got clinical, privacy and engineering to agree on where human review sits in the matching flow.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager - PMO (all genders)
jobs.description:
Your creative field We are looking for a full-time, permanent Technical Project Manager (all genders) to join our PMO team as soon as possible. We embrace a remote-first approach (within Germany), but you can choose whether you’d like to work in a hybrid model or entirely on-site, depending on your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Hamburg, Cologne, Munich).

 As a Senior Technical Project Manager, you are a cornerstone of strategy execution at Contabo – and you're joining at a time when a lot is moving strategically. Alongside the continued evolution of our existing cloud infrastructure, we are driving initiatives that will expand our portfolio well beyond what exists today over the coming years. This is exactly where your role comes in: embedded in our PMO, you take end-to-end ownership of technical projects across development teams and business functions – including initiatives for which no blueprint exists yet, where you help shape structures from the ground up. 

 You work at the intersection of technology and business: you translate sometimes still ambiguous requirements into executable plans, actively challenge requirements, and structure initiatives into scalable roadmaps, iterations, and implementation phases. In your day-to-day work, you coordinate priorities, dependencies, and delivery sequencing across multiple teams and parallel workstreams, identify resource bottlenecks and delivery risks early, and ensure transparency through structured reporting, clear governance, and effective escalation management – especially when scope and priorities shift in our fast-moving environment. You'll be working with tools like Jira, Confluence, and comparable solutions. 

 Beyond individual projects, you shape the PMO itself: you continuously develop our standards and processes, support portfolio alignment and prioritisation, and share your knowledge as a mentor to junior project managers. A lean PMO at Contabo means a high degree of autonomy and genuine ownership – you report directly to the Head of Strategy Execution & ESG and contribute measurably to the execution of Contabo's strategic roadmap. 

 What convinces us Your personality, paired with: 
 5+ years of experience in technical project or program management within software development or technical delivery organisations
 Proven end-to-end delivery ownership of cross-functional initiatives with multiple parallel workstreams – not limited to governance or status-reporting roles
 Strong experience in stakeholder and escalation management
 A high degree of ownership and composure in an environment of shifting priorities and ambiguity
 Confident use of common PM tooling such as Jira, Confluence (or comparable)
 Experience in a cloud, hosting, or IT infrastructure environment, as well as with agile scaling, PMO, or portfolio management (a plus)
 A completed degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Engineering, or a comparable qualification
 Professional fluency in English; German language skills and certifications (PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, PSM) are a plus
 We know that you may not currently meet all of these requirements. But if you bring the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm for the role, we can achieve great things together. 

 Awesome Prospects At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference. 
 What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.

 Work the way that fits your life  – Remote or hybrid with flexible hours for a healthy work-life balance and the same technical equipment at home as in the office 
 Experience real freedom  – Workation across the EU and in our summer office in Mallorca

 Feel comfortable where you work  – Modern, conveniently located offices across our European locations 
 Be part of a diverse team – Work in an international environment shaped by diversity 
 Create lasting memories  – Company events and team activities you won’t forget

Welcome to baramundi! “Where security, automation and centralized control come together, modern endpoint management begins.”
 
Do you want to actively shape modern UEM solutions, translate technical complexity into clear product decisions and create real value for IT administrators together with strong development teams? Then become part of our Management Suite Tribe and help drive the further development of our primarily on-premise Unified Endpoint Management solution as a Product Owner.

At baramundi, we develop software solutions that enable companies to centrally manage, secure and automate their endpoints. As a Product Owner, you work closely with development, Product Management, Support, Consulting and our customers in an agile, interdisciplinary environment. Your goal: to translate product requirements into valuable, prioritized and actionable features. 

 Do what you do best: DRIVE PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT IN THE MANAGEMENT SUITE TRIBE You take content responsibility for two development squads and, together with them, further develop key product areas of the baramundi Management Suite, primarily in Windows Endpoint Management – from fundamental client-server communication to compliance and defense management, Windows OS installation, co-management and Windows Update Management. You are part of the Product Owner Chapter and work closely within the leadership trio of Chapter Lead, Scrum Master and Product Owner.
 TRANSLATE REQUIREMENTS INTO CLEAR PRODUCT INCREMENTS You understand technical and functional complexity, formulate features and product backlog items precisely and ensure clear, testable acceptance criteria. You prioritize the product backlog based on customer value, effort, dependencies and stakeholder input.
 DELIVER WITH YOUR TEAMS You are the primary contact person for content-related and product-related questions from your development teams, make progress transparent and ensure that your squads can work in a focused, informed and empowered way. At the same time, you balance maintenance, quality and new features.
 BE THE BRIDGE BETWEEN PRODUCT, DEVELOPMENT AND STAKEHOLDERS You work closely with Product Management, Support, Consulting, customers as well as internal and external development partners, actively gather feedback and translate requirements into concrete development steps. In doing so, you represent product value just as clearly as the perspective of your teams.
 COORDINATE EXTERNAL PROJECTS AND DEVELOPMENT SERVICES You coordinate external teams and projects from a content perspective, ensure clear requirements, transparent alignment and reliable integration into product development.
 USE AI MEANINGFULLY IN YOUR PRODUCT OWNER ROUTINE You use AI tools in a reflective and pragmatic way – for example when creating features and PBIs, structuring requirements or developing quick prototypes for stakeholder feedback.
 

 What we appreciate about you: Several years of experience as a Product Owner or in a comparable role with product responsibility in an agile software development environment.
 Experience in providing content leadership for multiple development teams as well as integrating and coordinating external projects or developers.
 Confidence working with Scrum, Kanban and backlog tools – ideally Azure DevOps – as well as experience in scaled agile ways of working.
 Solid knowledge of or strong interest in Unified Endpoint Management, Client Lifecycle Management and Windows-based IT infrastructures.
 Ability to quickly understand technical complexity and translate it into clear, prioritizable requirements.

jobs.title: Product Manager (DevTools & AI Reliability, remote)
jobs.description:
(Fully remote, async-first, DevTools SaaS, 40h/week, time zones: UTC-3 to UTC+3) 
 The best developers don't wait for a customer to tell them something's broken.
 They catch it first, in the pull request, in staging, or in the checkout flow at 3am, before a single user notices. That instinct is Checkly's whole reason to exist. We give developers and their agents the tools to own reliability the way they own their code: monitoring defined as code, powered by OpenTelemetry and Playwright, versioned and reviewed like everything else they ship. From pull request to post-mortem, in one place.
 Thousands of them, from modern AI companies like Mistral and resolve.ai to large engineering orgs like LinkedIn, Citi, and 1Password, build with us. Now we need a PM who wants to take that further, in a market being rewritten in real time.
 Here's the thing about 2026: AI agents and coding assistants are shipping more software, faster, than any team could review by hand, and more of it is breaking in ways nobody has seen before. LLM-backed features fail probabilistically. Agents take actions no runbook anticipated. "Is my app healthy?" is becoming an unanswerable question for a whole generation of AI-native software. Nobody has really figured out what reliability means for this kind of software yet. That's the problem you'd own.
 
 What you'll do
 As a Product Manager, you will be responsible for empowering developers and designers to solve customer problems. You will work directly with our SVP Product Engineering Daniel .
 You will:
 Shape company and product strategy alongside our SVP of Product Engineering. It's a genuine partnership: you'll develop the vision for where Checkly goes next, decide where we play in the AI testing, monitoring, and observability landscape and where we don't, and turn that into a direction. You build the strategy with us, not execute someone else's.

 Shape Checkly's point of view on reliability in an AI-native world: how teams monitor AI-generated code, agent-driven workflows, and LLM-backed features

 Lead initiatives across Product Engineering, Sales and Marketing, and represent Checkly directly to customers and in developer communities.

 Live in the product and the problem. Empathy for DevOps, SRE and Platform Engineering isn't a line item. It's the job.

 You ship with AI where it helps and know when not to. You don't just talk about it.

 
 What you should have
 You've built software before this. You're an ex-engineer, ex-founder, or ex-solutions engineer who has written real code and shipped real things, and now you want to own the product. This one's non-negotiable: you should be able to reason about APIs, MCPs, CLIs, and how systems fit together without a translator.

 You've worked in a startup, not just a big company. You're comfortable with ambiguity, small teams, and owning outcomes end to end. You don't need a big-company machine around you to be effective.

 You've built technical products, ideally developer tools. Adjacent technical products count. Experience in monitoring or observability is a nice-to-have, not a requirement.

 New to the PM title? That's fine. If you're coming from a founding or solutions-engineering seat and want to go all-in on product, we want to hear from you.

 You're technical enough to be dangerous with AI tooling. You can prototype in code, throw together a mock, or pressure-test technical viability yourself when it moves things forward.

 FULLY remote role, within the UTC-3 to UTC+3 time zones. Need to be able to travel to (other) European countries without having to wait for a visa appointment.

 
 What you will hate about us
 We would rather tell you now than have you find out in month two.
 We use AI for everything, and we mean everything. AI skepticism is not a thing here. If you have the slightest hesitation about working with AI every day, this is not the place for you, and that is completely fine.

 We write more than we talk. We are async-first, so a lot of decisions happen in documents and threads, not meetings. If you do your best thinking out loud in a room full of people, you will miss it here.

 We are lean, so you own the boring parts too. There is no PM ops layer to delegate the unglamorous work to. You will do strategy one hour and clean up a messy spec the next.

 We ship constantly and change our minds. Priorities move as we learn from customers. If you need long, stable planning cycles, this will feel chaotic.

 Customer signals come first, and most of the time they beat your gut. We build what customers actually want, not the clever thing we dreamed up. Earn it by making customers happy, and then there is room for the moonshots. If you want to lead with your own bold bets, you will find this frustrating.

 
 Benefits
 Transparent salary because your salary shouldn't be dictated by how good a negotiator you are. (more info below)

 Remote-first , flexible work hours , async-first (low meeting, high productivity) and transparent c

jobs.title: Product Owner - Communications Channels & AI
jobs.description:
Role: Product Owner – Communication Channels & AI

 Location: Manchester

 Hours: Monday-Friday 8:45am-5:15pm

 Package: £80k OTE 

 

 As Product Owner - Technical Products, your role is to own and continuously improve PHMG's Technical product portfolio, ensuring Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE deliver measurable client value, operational quality and long-term commercial growth. 

 You are accountable for translating client needs, technology capability, partner opportunities and commercial priorities into scalable products and service models that strengthen adoption, retention and PHMG's competitive position. 

 Through H2 2026, you will lead the evolution of the technical product portfolio by bringing together product performance, platform capability, roadmap execution, client outcomes, commercial discipline, operational readiness and cross-functional alignment into one coherent product improvement agenda. 

 

 Key Objectives 

 Core Accountability 

 
 Own the strategy, design and ongoing performance of Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE.

 Set a clear, prioritised roadmap that balances client value, technical feasibility, commercial return, operational capacity and partner dependency.

 Ensure Technical products are positioned, sold, onboarded, serviced and renewed in a way that delivers measurable value for clients.

 Define the product standards, service models and client journeys that CS and Technical Production can execute consistently.

 Bring clarity to build, buy and partner decisions so product direction is deliberate, commercially disciplined and scalable.

 
 

 Technical Product Strategy & Roadmap 

 
 Define the long-term direction for Cloud Telephony, AI Receptionist and CCE, including the sequence of capability, integrations and service-model changes.

 Prioritise AI Receptionist growth across both horizontal capability and the vertical use cases where PHMG has the strongest right to win.

 Create a clear approach for CCE in the existing base, reducing under-utilisation and turning technical review, onboarding and value evidence into retention levers.

 Partner with the Creative Product Owner so the full product set feels coherent to clients and to the teams selling and servicing it.

 
 

 

 Client Experience, Adoption & Value Evidence 

 
 Define the client experience for Technical products across onboarding, configuration, in-life usage, renewal and offboarding.

 Clarify how clients access, configure and understand product value through the portal, including call flows, AI Receptionist behaviour, CCE setup and usage analytics.

 Ensure CS has the standards, data and language needed to evidence value, drive adoption and manage client expectations confidently.

 Identify where clients slow, stall or disengage, and build product or service-model interventions that protect retention.

 
 

 Commercial Performance & Partner Discipline 

 
 Own the commercial logic of the Technical portfolio, including pricing, CAC, cost-to-serve, gross margin, revenue performance and investment cases.

 Operationalise the GoTo resell model with clear pricing, service, process and margin controls while protecting the partner relationship.

 Use data to assess where Technical products create incremental value, where they cannibalise existing activity and where the model needs to change.

 Make active trade-offs between speed, quality, margin, client experience and platform investment.

 
 

 Operational Delivery & Launch Readiness 

 
 Work with Technical Production and Tech to define standards, SLAs, runbooks and support models for each product and release.

 Ensure new capabilities do not go live until operational readiness, client communications, CS briefings and support routes are clear.

 Create tight governance for launch decisions, technical dependencies, client escalations, recurring provisioning issues and partner constraints.

 Keep accountability clear between Product, Tech and Product Operations so issues are solved at the right level rather than absorbed by CS.

 
 

 Insight, Reporting & Continuous Improvement 

 
 Maintain a reliable view of product performance across adoption, usage, NPS, retention, revenue, margin, service issues and operational friction.

 Build structured feedback loops with CS, Client Insights, Sales, Tech and Technical Production to identify product problems worth solving.

 Turn recurring client or operational issues into permanent product, process, reporting or service-model improvements.

 Use performance data to make early decisions before product issues become retention, margin or client-experience risks.

 
 

 

 About PHMG: 

 Established in 1998, PHMG has grown from a renowned Manchester-based business to the world's leading audio branding agency – working with 36,000 clients in 54 countries across the globe. This expansive client list includes household names of the calibre of Samsung, Audi and Adidas, as well as SMEs in every sector of the glob

jobs.description:
Was diesen Job so besonders macht? Du analysierst gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen interne und externe Anforderungen, entwickelst daraus tragfähige technische Lösungskonzepte und berätst die Stakeholder entlang des gesamten Anforderungsprozesses, von der Problemstellung bis zur Erstellung von User Stories. 
 Du bewertest und priorisierst Anforderungen (Demands) hinsichtlich ihrer Dringlichkeit und ihres Nutzens und behältst dabei stets die Interessen der Stakeholder im Blick. 
 Du koordinierst und führst fachlich unsere agilenDevOps-Teams, um eine effiziente und zielgerichtete Umsetzung sicherzustellen. 
 Du verantwortest den Erfolg der umzusetzenden Anforderungen in Bezug auf Umfang, Aufwand, Zeit und Qualität und leitest bei Bedarf geeignete Maßnahmen in enger Abstimmung mit dem Team und den Anforderern ein. 
 Du gestaltest aktiv die kontinuierliche Optimierung und Digitalisierung der OXG IT-Landschaft sowie der zugrunde liegenden Geschäftsprozesse mit. 
 

 Wann passt Du zu uns? Mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner, IT -Projektmanager:in oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle, idealerweise mit abgeschlossenem Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik oder ähnlichem. 
 Umfassendes Wissen in Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von Datenmodellen, ETL-Prozessen und der Analyse und Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen in Cloud-Umgebungen (AWS) 
 Fundierte Kenntnisse agiler Methoden (Scrum, Kanban) und Tools (Jira, Confluence)  
 Ausgeprägtes analytisches und konzeptionelles Denkvermögen, gepaart mit technischem Verständnis für Datenflüsse, Schnittstellen und idealerweise SQL/Python-Kenntnissen. 
 Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeit, du kannst komplexe Inhalte klar und zielgruppengerecht vermitteln, Erwartungen aktiv managen und fundierte Entscheidungsvorlagen erstellen. 
 Hohe Eigeninitiative, Selbstorganisation und Engagement, du arbeitest strukturiert, strategisch und mit Blick fürs Wesentliche, auf Deutsch wie auf Englisch (verhandlungssicher). 
 

 Was kannst Du von uns erwarten? Flache Hierarchien mit Raum für Deine Ideen und konstruktives Feedback.

 Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Option, jederzeit innerhalb Deutschlands von zu Hause zu arbeiten und sogar bis zu  25 Tage im europäischen Ausland. 
 Monatlicher  Rabatt von 40 € auf Deine Mobilfunk- oder Festnetzrechnung durch unseren Partner Vodafone. 
 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr , plus Heiligabend und Silvester und mit Xtra-Plus bis zu  10 Tage unbezahlten Urlaub on top.
 Zuschuss für Dein  Bikeleasing über EURORAD für umweltfreundliches Pendeln und die Unterstützung Deiner Mitgliedschaft im  Urban Sports Club und Kooperation mit  awo lifebalance.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Manager, Browser Control Platform
jobs.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. 

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. 

About this team and role:

This role owns the foundation that lets other software drive Firefox: the secure, reliable connection an outside tool or another team uses to act inside the browser, and the building blocks they call to do it. It enables the teams building on it — internal teams, outside AI tools — to create their own products on top. This role owns the shared layer and the strategy for it. It’s a hands-on, technical role in a fast-moving, greenfield space, so it’s as much strategy as execution.

The opportunity is broad: internal teams (Smart Window, New Products’ automated tools), outside AI tools and their users, and web developers. The three share much of the underlying technology, but each reaches its market in a different way. The mandate is to figure out what to go after, and in what order.

What you’ll do:
  • Own the shared foundation and the building blocks it gives other software, and make them reliable and secure.
  • Push the open standard (WebDriver BiDi) forward, and build Firefox-only advantages the standard won’t cover 
  • Design the safety controls: let a person approve actions, see when software is acting for them, and take back control. 
  • Define the strategy for any major third-party AI assistants people already use.
  • Serve internal teams (Smart Window, New Products) and outside tools through one shared layer. 
Measured on:

Adoption across teams and tools, volume of usage through the platform, and sustained reliability and security.

What you'll bring:
  • A product-minded engineer, or a very technical PM who can drive a technical product 
  • Developer-space experience, with the range to think about consumers and internal platforms
  • Comfortable setting strategy in ambiguity; own a technical contract other teams depend on
  • Strong instincts on security and trust. Nice to have: web standards, MCP, browser automation

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget

 Du strukturierst, verhandelst und schließt Projektfinanzierungen für BESS-Anlagen eigenständig ab – von der Bankenansprache und dem Term Sheet bis zur Unterzeichnung und zum Financial Close.

 Conditions Precedent und Conditions Subsequent steuerst du ebenso verlässlich wie Kreditverträge, Sicherheiten Pakete und Intercreditor Agreements gemeinsam mit Banken und externen Rechtsberatern.

 Dein Profil

 
 Du hast ein wirtschaftswissenschaftliches oder vergleichbares Studium abgeschlossen und verfügst über fünf bis zehn Jahre Erfahrung in Project Finance, Infrastructure Finance oder Transaction Advisory für erneuerbare Energien.

 Mehrere non-recourse Projektfinanzierungen hast du nachweislich hands-on von der Term-Sheet-Phase bis zum Financial Close strukturiert und erfolgreich abgeschlossen.

 CFADS, DSCR, LLCR, Debt Sculpting, Covenants, Cash Sweeps, Reserve Accounts sowie CP- und CS-Management beherrschst du fachlich sicher.

 LMA-basierte Kreditverträge, Sicherheitenpakete und Intercreditor Agreements kannst du verhandlungssicher beurteilen und gemeinsam mit Rechtsberatern zum Abschluss führen.

 Excel nutzt du auf Expertenniveau und baust komplexe Projektfinanzierungsmodelle selbstständig auf; Szenario- und Sensitivitätsanalysen gehören zu deinem täglichen Handwerkszeug.

 Lender Due Diligence und externe Berater steuerst du souverän. Erfahrung mit BESS-Revenue-Streams, dem deutschen Regulierungsrahmen sowie M&A- oder Co-Investment-Strukturen ist ein starkes Plus.

 Direkter Einfluss darauf, welche großen Batteriespeicherprojekte in Deutschland finanziert und gebaut werden.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description:
THE LAST FRONTIER 
 The Arctic is a place of extremes: unforgiving, untamed, and undergoing rapid change. A literal defrosting reveals a multi-trillion-dollar opportunity spanning energy, defence, logistics, research, and infrastructure.
 
 ARD was founded on a paradox. The Arctic is both the next great economic frontier and one of the most hostile environments on Earth. Rich in resources and strategically vital, yet bone-chillingly cold, dark for months, and fundamentally inhospitable to humans. This paradox - an explosion of activity in a place that resists human presence - is why we exist. Our solution is autonomy.
 
 We build systems that operate reliably and intelligently in the Arctic, so that humans don't always have to.
 
 Founded by record-holding pioneers with decades of polar experience, we take calculated risks on hard problems that matter. If you want to build and deploy ground-up technology with real-world impact, at an inflection point in history that won’t reappear, we’d like to talk.
 
 ABOUT THE ROLE 
Our engineering team is expanding rapidly, and we’re looking for a Technical Project Manager to sit at the heart of it, driving delivery across our engineering portfolio. This is a hands-on role for someone who thrives on ambiguity, moves fast, and can bring order to multiple complex, multi-disciplinary hardware projects without slowing them down.
 
 You'll be responsible for planning, tracking, and de-risking delivery across products at varying stages of maturity - from early-TRL prototypes through to fielded, mission-ready systems - and from field-ready energy systems to autonomous surface and sub-surface platforms.

 WHAT YOU’LL DO 
 Own project planning and delivery tracking across concurrent engineering projects and work streams (firmware, electronics, mechanical, testing), translating product strategy and portfolio priorities into executable projects with clear milestones, owners, and outcomes.

 Convert ambitious commercial and operational deadlines into realistic, resourced delivery plans — holding the line on both ambition and delivery discipline.

 Maintain visibility across work streams, dependencies, risks, decisions, and resourcing gaps, managing technical risk and dependency mapping across products at different Technology Readiness Levels (TRL) and adjusting project rigour and testing requirements accordingly.

 Take ownership of BOMs for any existing and future products, manage key supplier relationships and keep track of all materials deliveries.

 Technical Expertise: Understand the architecture, dependencies, and technical challenges of hardware design and development. Support engineering teams in resolving technical issues. Ensure compliance with industry standards and government regulations, such as MIL-STD, UK DEFSTAN, and STANAG testing and qualification requirements across the product lifecycle.

 Act as the connective tissue across engineering, procurement, business development, security, product, commercial, and customers — driving cross-functional alignment and ensuring technical progress, customer commitments, and delivery constraints are understood on all sides.

 Identify and resolve blockers fast, escalate early and clearly, and provide concise, decision-ready updates on consequential tradeoffs.

 Build and refine the project management tooling, processes, and reporting cadence as ARD scales — you'll be creating much of this from scratch.

 Identify missing handoffs and unwritten work, converting them into accountable plans, and facilitate requirements and scope definition with product, customer, and technical owners.

 Lead pilots, implementations, migrations, rollouts, adoption, and operational handoffs.

 
 WHAT YOU’LL BRING 
 Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Computer, Aerospace, Mechanical Engineering, or adjacent discipline - or - experience working in a technical engineering role prior to working as a project manager.

 4+ years proven experience in Technical Engineering Project Management across multiple concurrent projects,, delivering complex hardware products, ideally in defence, aerospace, or another regulated hardware environment; and ideally at a range of company maturity stages.

 Working familiarity with MIL-STD testing standards, UK DEFSTAN, and NATO STANAG requirements, and how these shape project planning and qualification timelines.

 Comfort operating across a range of TRL levels — from early, rapid prototyping and experimentation through to production-grade delivery — and judgement on how to flex process accordingly.

 A genuine start-up mentality: comfortable with ambiguity, resourcefulness, and getting hands dirty where needed, rather than waiting for the perfect process.

 A track record of hitting ambitious deadlines in fast-moving, resource-constrained environments.

 Strong stakeholder management skills — able to communicate technical risk and progress clearly to both engineers and non-technical leadership.

jobs.title: EMEA Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over one billion interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role:

As Senior Product Marketing Manager, you will drive global adoption of Parloa's AI agents by CX teams and contact centers, owning the positioning, launches, and sales enablement that bring our AI Agent Management Platform (Parloa AMP) to market. You will set how Parloa differentiates itself in a noisy AI agent market, translate our product roadmap into a story customers care about, and give sales the material they need to win.This is your opportunity to define the category narrative for enterprise AI agents at the exact moment the market is being formed.

Areas of ownership:

  • Go-to-Market Strategy: Define positioning and messaging for Parloa products, orchestrate product communication plans, and drive cross-functional launches across Product, Marketing, Sales, and CX.
  • Product and Roadmap Alignment: Partner with Product and Engineering so the roadmap ladders up to the company narrative and GTM plan, and keep prospects, partners, and customers informed at every step.
  • Sales Enablement: Sharpen how Sales positions the platform through customer use cases, proof points, collateral, training sessions, and competitive differentiators built with our Enablement and Competitive Intelligence teams.
  • Market Awareness and Thought Leadership: Source content ideas, shape outlines, create and review content, and speak on webinars alongside our Content team, Evangelists, CX team, and executives.
  • Competitive Differentiation: Establish a deep understanding of the market, customers, and competition, then turn that insight into positioning that separates Parloa from the field.

Who you are:

  • 6+ years in Product Marketing, or 8+ years in adjacent roles working alongside a PMM team (sales enablement, B2B direct marketing).
  • Experience at an AI company or marketing AI products or capabilities.
  • An excellent writer with samples to prove it.
  • A proven track record supporting enterprise sales teams with storylines, collateral, enablement, and individual deal support.
  • A confident presenter who holds an audience on webinars, at company events, and in Sales training sessions.
  • Ambidextrous across strategy and tactics. You have crafted a product narratives and also built the sales deck from scratch, screenshots and all, when speed mattered more than polish.
  • You are experienced at using AI tools to help you be more creative, efficient, and productive.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English is required.
  • Pluses:
    • Experience with CX tools (contact center, customer service, digital experience software).
    • Business-fluent German is great, but not required.

Our recruiting process:

Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We’re a scale-up, having moved beyond our earliest startup phase. But we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:

You will define product solutions, scope, and success metrics for content-rich, UX-heavy customer journeys, and you will drive measurable improvements in storefront performance such as add-to-cart and checkout conversion. Working closely with UX, development, analytics, performance marketing, and country teams, you will structure complex product information into clear, attractive pages that reflect a premium brand experience.
 PERGOLUX designs and sells Scandinavian-inspired outdoor living products, from pergolas to garden furniture, directly to consumers. With around 300 employees, 9-figure revenue, and operations across 8 markets, we have grown consistently across Europe and beyond, building a collaborative international team along the way.
 What You'll Do 
 • Own eCommerce product initiatives from concept to launch and optimization, defining scope, risks, requirements, and success metrics.
 • Conduct product discovery through user research, competitor analysis, usability testing, and synthesizing customer feedback into product decisions.
 • Create page concepts, wireframes, prototypes, copy drafts, and visual briefs, and write clear specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
 • Plan delivery with development, managing priorities, dependencies, QA, releases, rollout logic, toggles, and rollback plans.
 • Monitor launches and use analytics, A/B testing, and experimentation to drive rapid fixes and follow-up improvements to storefront performance.
 What You'll Bring 
 • 5+ years in product management for eCommerce products, with strong experience in UX-heavy, content-rich customer journeys.
 • Proven ability to structure complex product information into clear, simple, and attractive pages, backed by customer research and insight-driven decisions.
 • Strong visual taste and an understanding of what makes a premium digital brand experience, plus the ability to create concepts, wireframes, and copy drafts independently.
 • Solid command of CRO, analytics, A/B testing, and storefront performance optimization, and a track record of aligning UX, developers, analytics, and marketing.
 • Nice to have: experience with Shopify or other storefront platforms, high-ticket or considered-purchase eCommerce, premium/lifestyle brands, and building repeatable product processes or templates.

 💼 Compensation — Competitive salary that reflects your expertise and rewards results · Company pension plan · Capped overtime, fully paid, with no endless unpaid crunch
 🚀 Growth and Career Development — You will take on real ownership from the start with direct impact on key business outcomes, work alongside an international team across Europe, and follow fast-track opportunities to grow into senior leadership roles as PERGOLUX scales.
